title: I built the UK government’s metascience unit — here’s what countries need to know
title_zh: 我建立了英国政府的元科学单位——各国需要知道什么
abstract: To find evidence-backed ways to improve grant-funding processes, metascientists need freedom and money to experiment, as well as leaders who are willing to make change.
abstract_zh: 要为改进资助流程寻找有证据支持的方法，元科学家需要自由和资金来开展实验，以及愿意推动变革的领导者。
snippet: To find evidence-backed ways to improve grant-funding processes, metascientists need freedom and money to experiment, as well as leaders who are willing to make change.
